userStories.title: Resilient external API client core
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one shared building block for calling any external API so retry/backoff/quota logic isn't reinvented per integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared client wrapper function with exponential backoff + jitter on 429/5xx responses and a max attempt count
api_quota_usage table helper: recordUsage(provider, units) and checkQuota(provider, unitsNeeded) that pre-checks a configurable daily cap
Every exhausted-retry failure writes a row to error_logs with provider, operation, payload summary, attempt count

Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: src/lib/resilient-client.ts: callWithRetry() wraps any async op returning {status}; retries on thrown errors and on 429/5xx statuses with exponential backoff (baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt-1)) plus +/-25% jitter, injectable sleep/random for deterministic tests, max attempts configurable. On exhaustion throws typed RetryExhaustedError (provider/operation/attempts/cause) and, if an ErrorLogStore is supplied, writes one error_logs row (provider, operation, payloadSummary, errorMessage, attemptCount). src/lib/quota.ts: QuotaStore abstraction (getUsage/incrementUsage) with createDrizzleQuotaStore() backed by api_quota_usage (upsert via onConflictDoUpdate on provider+usageDate); checkQuota() throws typed QuotaExceededError when usedUnits+neededUnits exceeds a configurable dailyCap, recordUsage() increments the counter. src/lib/error-log.ts: ErrorLogStore abstraction + createDrizzleErrorLogStore() backed by error_logs. Store abstractions let unit tests use in-memory fakes instead of a real DB. 14 new unit tests (resilient-client: success path, 429 retry+succeed, 5xx retry+succeed, non-retryable 4xx short-circuits, exhausted retries throws+logs, thrown network errors retried+logged, typed error fields; quota: under/at/over cap, error field details, zero-usage default, recordUsage increments + isolates by provider/date). tsc --noEmit clean, eslint . clean, vitest run 27/27 passing.

userStories.title: Cost estimator

userStories.notes: src/lib/cost-estimator.ts: estimateCost(provider, specs) -- per_second multiplies unitPrice*durationSeconds, per_generation returns the flat unitPrice, per_credit multiplies unitPrice*(specs.credits ?? 1) (added an optional `credits` field to GenerationSpecs for this, defaulting to 1 generation = 1 credit when a provider doesn't specify). Accepts unitPrice as either a JS number or the numeric-as-string shape Drizzle returns for `numeric` columns. Result rounded to 4 decimal places to match the estimated_cost/actual_cost/unit_price numeric(10,4) columns. Exhaustive switch with a `never` check so a future pricing model addition fails to typecheck until handled here. 6 unit tests covering all three pricing models, the credits-omitted default, numeric vs string unitPrice input, and rounding. tsc --noEmit clean, eslint . clean, vitest run 66/66 passing.

userStories.notes: src/actions/platform-connections.ts: setConnectionStatus (upsert via onConflictDoUpdate targeting the niche_id+platform unique constraint) and getConnectionsForNiche. No channel column, same rationale as niches.ts (never Telegram-triggered). src/app/niches/actions.ts: updateConnectionStatusAction parses nicheId/platform/status via zod then calls setConnectionStatus, revalidating both /niches and /niches/[id]. src/app/niches/[id]/page.tsx: Platform connections section rendered as a state machine of contextual buttons per platform -- disconnected shows "Mark as submitted for review"; pending_review shows "Mark as active" (primary) + "Reset"; active shows "Disconnect" -- each a tiny form posting straight to updateConnectionStatusAction via hidden nicheId/platform/status fields. Status pills use per-platform pending copy (PENDING_LABELS) matching the PRD wording: tiktok="Waiting on TikTok audit", instagram="Waiting on Meta app review", youtube="Waiting on Google OAuth verification"; disconnected="Not connected", active="Active". Explicit copy that this is a manual flag, not a live OAuth check. 5 new unit tests (src/actions/platform-connections.test.ts) against the real pglite-backed test db: create-when-absent, upsert-not-duplicate (+ updatedAt bump), reset-to-disconnected, independent-per-platform tracking, empty-array-when-none. Manual verification went further than US-009: temp local Postgres 17 (TCP loopback from the start, avoiding the unix-socket drizzle-kit migrate bug found in US-009) -> migrate -> seed providers -> seeded one niche via psql with zero connection rows -> next build/next start -> logged in via curl through the real password gate -> confirmed the zero-rows case renders all three platforms as disconnected/"Not connected" -> then actually replicated Next.js's Server Action no-JS wire protocol by hand (multipart POST with the hidden $ACTION_ID_<hash> field plus nicheId/platform/status) to drive updateConnectionStatusAction for real over HTTP: disconnected->pending_review->active->disconnected full cycle for tiktok, each transition confirmed both via a direct psql SELECT against platform_connections and via re-fetching the page and checking the correct pill color/label and contextual button set rendered; also verified instagram's distinct pending copy ("Waiting on Meta app review"). Tore down the temp Postgres instance and Next.js server afterward. tsc --noEmit clean, eslint . clean, vitest run 79/79 passing.
